description: This file defines a React component called ProtectedRoute that enforces authentication on certain routes by checking user session via context. It renders different UI states based on loading and authentication status, including a skeleton loader, access restriction message, and navigation options.

methods.name: ProtectedRoute({ children, redirectTo = "/" })
methods.description: A React functional component that protects routes by requiring an authenticated session. It displays a loading skeleton while resolving session, or prompts unauthenticated users to sign in.
